text: {"lessons":["I sold each position at a gain early on, then bought back later; feeling good about a realized gain is not a reliable reason to sell or buy.","After buying again in Period 6, I held through both declines and a rebound; short-term moves are unpredictable, so I should decide based on my plan rather than trying to time them.","I often judge each stock against its own average cost, but that can make losses especially hard to accept; I should consider the whole account and not let my purchase price dictate a trade."]}
